subject: Trial command & control — success criteria, owners, timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena@orchidanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Trial command & control — success criteria, owners, timeline

Hi Elena (and team),

Thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier today. Per our conversation, I put together a short "command & control" plan for the 3-week trial so we can align on success metrics, who owns which piece, and immediate next steps. This is a working draft — please flag changes.

Summary (high level)
- Trial length: 3 weeks (kickoff week = onboarding/smoke; week 2 = load/scale; week 3 = regression/quality checks)
- Core success criteria (customer-sourced):
  - Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms for typical chat flows (50–100 token responses)
  - Throughput: sustain >= 50 QPS for batched inference in peak window
  - Cost: average per-request token cost target <$0.01 (incl. caching & batching)
  - Accuracy/regressions: no critical quality regressions on the provided eval set (precision/recall baseline)
- Minimum deliverables: onboarding runbook, test harness, short runbook for fallbacks

Proposed ownership (command & control)
- Infra (GPU instances, network, VPC peering): Karthik Iyer (redwood)
- App integration (API calls, payload schema, sample client): Monica Patel (redwood)
- Security/compliance checks (SSO, KMS, audit logs): Stephanie Nguyen (redwood) — Stephanie, can you confirm any blockers?
- Procurement / contracts / PO / billing: Elena + Tom Reed (Orchid) — quick approval needed for reserved capacity trial if usage spikes

Immediate next steps
1) Kickoff call — suggest Tue Dec 8, 10:00 PT. Goal: runbook handoff + infra access
2) Redwoods to share trial playbook & milestone sheet (attached) by EOD Dec 6
3) Orchid to confirm test dataset and primary evaluation queries by Dec 9
4) Security swipe: specify SSO/KMS needs; supply contact info for procurement (PO owner)

Attachments (initial): redwood_trial_playbook_v1.pdf (trial playbook), trial_milestones_sheet.xlsx (milestones + owners)

If that aligns, I'll schedule the kickoff and loop in our infra ops Slack channel for access provisioning.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Solutions 
Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]

From: Elena Morris <elena@orchidanalytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@orchidanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Trial command & control — success criteria, owners, timeline

Thanks Jordan — this is exactly what we needed to move forward. A few clarifications from our side:

- Timeline: Tue Dec 8 at 10:00 PT works for kickoff.
- Security: Tom (cc'd) is our cloud security lead — he'll need to confirm SSO + KMS integration details. We also need a short statement of Redwood's SOC 2 scope for the trial environment. Is that something Stephanie can provide?
- Procurement: We typically issue a PO for pilot capacity. Tom will be the internal approver; I'll try to get a preliminary PO in advance of heavy load testing.
- Evaluation dataset: we'll share a 200-query eval set + annotated examples by Dec 9 EOD. We also have a small production copy of traffic (sanitized) for load tests — Tom will share access instructions if needed.

Two asks for Redwood before kickoff:
1) A short one-page security checklist for the trial (SSO, KMS, logging, data retention)
2) An updated milestone sheet with owner names filled in (we can use that to route PO approvals)

I appreciate the clear owners here. Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Elena
Elena Morris
Head of Product
Orchid Analytics

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Elena Morris <elena@orchidanalytics.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@orchidanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial command & control — success criteria, owners, timeline

Jordan / team —

I pulled together a technical onboarding checklist and filled owners in the milestones sheet (attached). High-level plan from infra perspective:

Tech onboarding (Karthik)
- Access: request temporary IAM role for Orchid service account; we will do a one-hour IAM setup during kickoff
- Network: VPC peering plan + firewall rules; aim to have peering live within 48 hours of kickoff
- Model variant & config: recommend starting with quantized v2 (balanced perf/cost); will document kernel config in playbook
- KV cache: enable prefix caching for the first 100k tokens to control costs during load runs

Action items (owners & dates)
- Karthik: prep infra playbook + peering instructions — by EOD Dec 9 [attachment: trial_milestones_sheet.xlsx]
- Monica: provide sample API client and payload contract to Orchid — by Dec 9
- Stephanie: security checklist (SOC 2 scope, KMS requirements, logging retention policy) — by Dec 9
- Elena/Tom: provide eval dataset & confirm PO owner — by Dec 9

Note on SLAs during trial: we will not change production routing; Redwood will provide elevated on-call during the 3-week window to ensure quick turnarounds for infra issues. If Orchid expects reserved capacity, we'll surface cost implications ahead of the load test.

I attached the milestones sheet with owner columns populated. See attachment: trial_milestones_sheet.xlsx

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Cloud Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Trial command & control — success criteria, owners, timeline

Perfect — thanks for the fast turn. Two quick confirmations before kickoff:

1) Deliverables in Git/Drive by EOD Dec 9: updated trial playbook, milestones sheet (owners), and one-page security checklist (Stephanie)
2) Kickoff: Tue Dec 8, 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent) — agenda: runbook handoff, IAM peering steps, test harness validation

I'll also open a short channel in our Slack (#orchid-pilot) for real-time coordination during the trial. If procurement needs a draft SOW or price sheet for reserved capacity sign-off, Monica and I can share a short form SOW (attached: sow-draft.docx).

Next step: Jordan to add DocuSign link for the pilot SOW once Orchid confirms PO owner.

Looking forward to it.

—Jordan
